abstract: In most studies concerning organ-specific metastasis, different or selected lines are compared with one another. Here we report results with the same cell line (the F9 murine teratocarcinoma) which can be directed towards liver or lung, depending on whether or not it is treated with retinoic acid and cyclic AMP. Thus, organ-specific colonization by tail-vein-injected murine F9 teratocarcinoma cells shows a particular pattern: unselected, undifferentiated F9 cells preferentially colonize the liver of the syngeneic animal. The lungs, the first capillary bed encountered by cells thus injected, are only very rarely colonized. By contrast, the lungs become the main target organ of F9 cells induced to differentiate by treatment with retinoic acid and cyclic AMP. We have recently shown that liver colonization by undifferentiated F9 cells correlated with the adhesiveness of the cells (higher to fibronectin and liver-derived extracellular matrix than to laminin and lung-derived extracellular matrix) as well as with their growth response to organ-derived extracts (no response with lung extracts and good response with liver extracts). The data reported below indicate that induction of differentiation causes at most a decreased adhesiveness of F9 cells to all the substrata tested (laminin, fibronectin, type-IV collagen, organ-derived extracellular matrix), suggesting that the shift in organ colonization observed with differentiated F9 cells is not due to an enhancement of the specific adhesion to the lung matrix. On the other hand, differentiated cells, but not undifferentiated ones, were able to respond to growth stimulation mediated by lung-derived extracts, thereby implying a relevant role for organ-specific growth stimulation in lung colonization by differentiated F9 cells.
abstract_ja: 対象は同一の細胞株であるマウスF9奇形癌(teratocarcinoma)細胞で、レチノイン酸とcAMPによる処理の有無によって肝臓または肺への定着の方向が変わる。未分化のF9細胞は、尾静脈から注入すると同系マウスの肝臓に優先的に定着する。注入された細胞が最初に遭遇する毛細血管床である肺には、ごく稀にしか定着しない。一方、レチノイン酸とcAMPで分化誘導したF9細胞では、肺が主要な標的臓器となる。未分化F9細胞の肝臓定着は、細胞の接着能(フィブロネクチンおよび肝臓由来細胞外基質への接着が、ラミニンおよび肺由来細胞外基質への接着より高い)と、臓器由来抽出物に対する増殖応答(肺抽出物には応答せず、肝臓抽出物には良好に応答)に相関することをすでに示していた。今回のデータは、分化誘導によって、試験したすべての基質(ラミニン、フィブロネクチン、IV型コラーゲン、臓器由来細胞外基質)への接着能がむしろ低下することを示した。このため、分化F9細胞で見られる肺への定着の変化は、肺基質への特異的接着の増強によるものではないと考えられる。一方、分化細胞は、未分化細胞とは異なり、肺由来抽出物による増殖刺激に応答した。これは、分化F9細胞の肺定着において臓器特異的な増殖刺激が重要な役割を果たすことを示唆する。
